title: Silent trace loss — execution completed but trace POST failed and system proceeded anyway
description: Vessel executes activity successfully, attempts POST /v2/activities/execution-traces, hits network blip / activity-api 5xx / auth refresh in-flight. Trace is lost. System proceeds as if learning loop captured it. Posterior never updates. Activity that should have α-incremented stays at prior. Repeats invisibly: high-volume tasks under-count successes; recommendation slowly drifts toward over-sampled (visible) variants.

preconditions: trace POST returns non-2xx OR client times out before ACK
vessel has no retry/persist-and-retry policy for trace submission

registry_modifications.action: Inject a synthetic 'trace_loss_canary' impulse-write that vessels are expected to emit alongside execution traces. Trace successfully posted but canary missing → trace was likely lost in earlier instance.

goal_text: Detect divergence between vessel-side execution counts and activity-api trace counts over rolling 24h windows. For each vessel, compute (observed local executions − stored remote traces) and surface vessels with >5% loss. Propose a trace-redelivery activity that maintains a local outbox per vessel and re-submits missing traces.

detection.signal: Vessel's self-reported execution count (from heartbeat metadata or local counters) > activity-api's stored trace count for that vessel_id over the same time window. The gap exceeds 5% and is sustained over ≥ 3 consecutive windows.
detection.query_template: SELECT vessel_id, COUNT(*) FROM activity_execution_traces WHERE created_at BETWEEN $start AND $end GROUP BY vessel_id; COMPARE against vessel-local counter snapshot from heartbeat payload.

subagent_investigation.findings_summary: ias-executor-ts TranslatingTraceSink swallows non-2xx and transport errors with no retry — failed traces are DROPPED. MiniBob has a trace cache that persists to ~/.metabob/.cache/traces/ but no background sync thread; redelivery only fires when sync() is explicitly called. AgentRuntime tracks executionsCompleted locally and sends to /v2/vessels/heartbeat (not discovery-vessel). Activity-api has no endpoint to expose per-vessel recorded trace count, so the counter-divergence check the harness needs is not currently queryable.
code_references: repos/minibob/src/mcp.ts:3108-3145 (storeExecutionTrace — caches on error, no abort)
repos/discovery-vessel/src/registry.ts:166-193 (heartbeat accepts metrics.executionsCompleted but minibob doesn't send it here)
current_gaps_in_codebase: ias-executor-ts has no durable outbox — traces silently dropped on POST failure
MiniBob trace-cache lacks background sync thread; entries sit until explicit sync()
No idempotency/dedup key on trace POST; redelivery could double-write
